app.name: Everlast
app.description: Upload your documents and get answers you can verify — every claim linked back to the exact passage it came from.

auth.signUpSubtitle: Start reasoning over your own sources.
auth.confirmationSent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish signing up.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password combination is not correct.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first — check your inbox.
auth.weakPassword: Choose a longer password — at least 12 characters.
auth.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notebooks.title: Notebooks
notebooks.subtitle: {count, plural, =0 {No notebooks yet} one {# notebook} other {# notebooks}}
notebooks.createSubtitle: Give it a name. You can add sources next.
notebooks.emptyBody: A notebook holds a set of sources and everything you learn from them. Create one to begin.
notebooks.sourceCount: {count, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}}
notebooks.deleteBody: “{title}” and all of its sources, chats and notes will be removed. This cannot be undone.

sources.title: Sources
sources.emptyBody: Add a PDF, a document, a web page or pasted text. Everlast will read it and answer from it.
sources.dropzoneHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown · up to 50 MB
sources.pastePlaceholder: Paste anything you want to reason over…
sources.removeBody: “{title}” will be removed from the notebook, along with everything indexed from it.
sources.limitReached: This notebook has reached its source limit.
sources.duplicate: That source is already in this notebook.

chat.title: Chat
chat.placeholderNoSources: Add a source to start asking questions
chat.emptyBody: Every answer is grounded in what you uploaded, with citations you can click to check.
chat.suggestion2: What do the sources disagree about?
chat.suggestion3: List the main findings with evidence
chat.scopedToSelection: Answering from {count, plural, one {# selected source} other {# selected sources}}
chat.failed: The answer could not be completed. Please try again.

notes.title: Notes
notes.emptyBody: Save an answer from the chat, or write your own.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Turn your sources into something you can use.
studio.emptyBody: Pick a format below and Everlast will build it from your sources.
studio.kindBriefingDocHint: An executive summary with themes and quotes
studio.kindFaqHint: The questions your sources actually answer
studio.kindTimelineHint: Events in order, plus who is involved
studio.started: Generating — this can take a minute.
studio.audioUnavailable: Audio is not configured on this deployment — the script is shown instead.

sharing.title: Share
sharing.shareSubtitle: People you add can open this notebook and ask questions.
sharing.roleEditorHint: Add and remove sources, write notes
sharing.noAccount: No Everlast account uses that email address yet.
sharing.lastOwner: A notebook must always have at least one owner.

common.errorBody: That did not work. Please try again.
common.notFoundBody: This page does not exist, or you no longer have access to it.
